//: Compile-time engine boundary check. The engine must stay DOM- and React-free, so it is typechecked against a lib set that does NOT include the DOM. Any DOM type (HTMLElement, CanvasRenderingContext2D, ImageData, ResizeObserver, MediaQueryList, IntersectionObserver, React) becomes a compile error here even though the main build would accept it. Run with `npm run typecheck:engine`.
